data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node 0d64405bfceb DEPENDS ON SRC_003's 'Logical Asymmetry' but restricts its application to 'Non-Stationary Systems'. It argues that the asymmetry of falsification only justifies preference when the underlying laws of the system are assumed stable; in non-stationary systems, past survival implies nothing about future vulnerability, breaking the link. REFUTED IF: A non-stationary system is found where theories surviving past tests continue to predict future states better than random chance, indicating that some form of induced stability persists despite non-stationarity.
